About Bambina FoodForge Technologies

Engineering-Led Food & Feed Processing Solutions

Based in Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu, India, Bambina FoodForge Technologies (BFT) is an innovative food and feed processing engineering company committed to transforming customer ideas into practical, efficient, and commercially viable production solutions.

01

Our Purpose

We specialise in research, development, and customised product development across food processing machinery, feed processing machinery, special-purpose machines, and laboratory or testing equipment—helping customers move confidently from initial concept to commercial production.

02

Our Business Scope

We operate across the complete value chain of food, feed, agricultural, and allied processing engineering—covering research, product development, custom design, manufacturing, sourcing, supply, retailing, installation, commissioning, automation, and technical support for individual machines as well as complete turnkey plants.

03

Our Approach

Our services cover the entire project journey, starting from initial concept development, feasibility assessment, project planning, financial advisory, and budget preparation. We guide machinery selection based on production capacity, product requirements, automation level, available space, and investment budget.

How BFT Works With You Across the Equipment Lifecycle

Where practical, we evaluate the complete relationship between Product → Process → Machinery → Capacity → Automation → Utilities → Installation → Operation → Maintenance.

1. Machinery Manufacturer

Custom machinery design, fabrication, and engineered equipment solutions tailored to specific food, feed, and agricultural applications.

2. Equipment Supplier

Reliable machinery and equipment sourcing, procurement, and supply aligned with your capacity, utility, and budget parameters.

3. Turnkey Project Handler

End-to-end processing line engineering, plant layout, utilities integration, installation, commissioning, and trial production.

4. After-Sales Service Provider

Operator and maintenance training, SOP guidance, troubleshooting, spares assistance, future upgrades, and chargeable AMC support.

Our Vision
“To become a trusted engineering and technology partner for the food, feed, agricultural and allied processing industries, enabling customers to turn promising ideas into practical, efficient and scalable production solutions.”
Bambina FoodForge Technologies (BFT) Practical • Efficient • Scalable
Our Mission
“To understand each customer’s product, process and business requirements, then provide suitable engineering, machinery, project planning and lifecycle support. We aim to help customers move from concept to commercial production through customised solutions, responsible guidance, technical training and dependable after-sales service.”

Custom Engineering & Research

Custom Machinery Development, Prototyping & R&D

Standard off-the-shelf machinery does not always fit regional ingredients, novel recipes, or constrained factory layouts. At Bambina FoodForge Technologies, we engineer solutions built around your specific product, process, capacity, available space, automation requirements, and budget.

1. Custom Machinery Development

Purpose-built special-purpose machines designed from first principles to handle defined mechanical or thermal processing tasks.

2. Engineering Design & Analysis

3D CAD modelling, material selection, thermal and airflow calculations, and hygienic equipment design using AutoCAD, SolidWorks, and ANSYS Thermal.

3. Prototyping & Trial Testing

Systematic fabrication of pilot prototypes, trial runs with actual raw materials, parameter refinement, and performance validation before scale-up.

4. Embedded & Process Controls

Custom electrical control panels, sensor integration, and embedded control approaches matched to your required level of automation.

Discuss a Custom Machine Enquire About R&D Support
Knowledge Transfer & Lifecycle Care

Training, Technical Support & Annual Maintenance Contracts (AMC)

Consistent production requires connecting machine knowledge, process knowledge, product knowledge, and operator skills. We follow a structured training methodology: Explain → Demonstrate → Operate → Observe → Correct → Standardise.

1. Operator Training

Machine operation, safety protocols, control panel usage, routine start-up/shut-down procedures, and basic daily care.

2. Technical & Maintenance Training

Machine sub-systems, preventive maintenance schedules, wear-part inspection, troubleshooting, and basic fault identification.

3. Trial Running & Commissioning

On-site equipment commissioning, load testing, initial process trials with raw materials, and production start-up assistance.

4. Process Optimisation

Fine-tuning operating parameters based on raw material variations, formulations, machine settings, and desired product characteristics.

5. Product Development & Standardisation

For selected food-processing projects: formulation trials, product development support, and converting trial recipes into repeatable manufacturing procedures.

6. SOP & Process Documentation

Preparation of clear Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and batch process documentation to maintain day-to-day production consistency.

7. Troubleshooting & Spare-Parts Assistance

Remote technical guidance or site visits depending on requirement, alongside preventive maintenance guidance and spare-part identification/replacement coordination.

8. Machinery Upgradation

Engineering modifications, control retrofits, process improvements, and capacity enhancements as your business requirements evolve.

Structured Training Programs for Different Customer Teams

Lifecycle Equipment Care

Annual Maintenance Contracts (AMC)

  • Scheduled Maintenance
  • Periodic Equipment Inspection
  • Priority Technical Support
  • On-Site / Remote Troubleshooting

  • Spare-Part Assistance

Product Presentation & Shelf Readiness

Packaging & Labelling Support

In addition to machinery, process development, and project consultancy, Bambina FoodForge Technologies provides practical guidance and project support for product packaging, labelling, and market-readiness requirements—helping protect product quality, extend shelf stability, and improve customer presentation.

01

Product & Packaging Assessment

Understanding physical product characteristics (powder, granule, liquid, paste, whole snack/grain), shelf-life goals, and target distribution channels.

02

Packaging Format Evaluation

Evaluating practical pack formats (pouches, stand-up zippers, jars, bottles, bulk bags, trays, or vacuum packs) suited to the product and market.

03

Packaging Material Guidance

Preliminary guidance on selecting suitable food-grade barrier films, laminates, or rigid containers based on moisture, oxygen, and hygiene needs.

04

Filling & Sealing Methods

Guidance on volumetric, weighmetric, auger, or liquid filling alongside proper heat-sealing, induction sealing, nitrogen flushing, or closure systems.

05

Labelling Support

Practical guidance for product labelling formats, label placement, and coordinating informational layout for retail or institutional packs.

06

Batch Coding & Date Printing

Assisting customers in selecting suitable batch coding, date printing, and traceability solutions for manual, semi-automatic, or automatic lines.

07

Packaging Machinery Selection

Identifying suitable form-fill-seal (FFS), pouch packing, weighing, sealing, strapping, or secondary packaging machinery matched to line output.

08

Product Presentation & Integration

Connecting processing technology, packaging line speed, and project planning so your finished product reaches market readiness smoothly.

Structured Packaging Workflow

Product → Pack Format → Packaging Material → Filling → Sealing → Coding → Labelling → Secondary Packaging → Market Readiness
